<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>false</active><api_name>x_1777187_rental_0.GetCustomerDetails</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>GetCustomerDetails</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var GetCustomerDetails = Class.create();
GetCustomerDetails.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
 
    getDetails: function() {
        var customerId = this.getParameter('sysparm_customer_id');
        var result = {};
        if (!customerId) return JSON.stringify(result);
 
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_1777185_home_s_0_customer_details');
        gr.addQuery('sys_id', customerId);  
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        gr.query();
 
        if (gr.next()) {
            result.email = gr.email+'';
            result.contact_number = gr.mobile_number+'';
            result.street_line_1 = gr.street_line_1+'';
            result.street_line_2 = gr.street_line_2+'';
            result.street_line_3 = gr.street_line_3+'';
            result.city = gr.city+'';
            result.district = gr.district+'';
            result.state = gr.state+'';
            result.pin_code = gr.pin_code+'';  
        }
 
        return JSON.stringify(result);
    },
    type:'GetCustomerDetails'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-14 05:43:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>1875a8e4833ae650216cf7a6feaad387</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GetCustomerDetails</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Rental Properties System" source="x_1777187_rental_0">0e95d49e83aaea10216cf7a6feaad387</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Rental Properties System">0e95d49e83aaea10216cf7a6feaad387</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_1875a8e4833ae650216cf7a6feaad387</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-14 06:20:28</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
